full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal, J: This appeal by leave by the accused-appellant is from the judgment  and order dated 26.8.96 passed by a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division rejecting the appellants application for condonation of delay and also rejecting the Memorandum of Appeal as being barred by limitation. 

 2. The convicted appellant was tried in absentia by the Drug Judge, Dhaka in Drug Case No. 8 of 1988 and was convicted by judgment dated 30.11.93 under sections 16A, 16B and 20 of the Drugs (Control) Ordinance, 1982 and sentenced to 2 years R.I. and to pay a fine of Tk. 5,000/-, in default to suffer R.I. for 3 months. The appellant was arrested on 25.6.96. He filed an appeal before the High Court Division against the aforesaid order of conviction and sentence, Criminal Appeal No. 1250 of 1996, accompanied by an application for condonation of delay of 926 days in filing the appeal. By the impugned judgment and order a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division rejected the application for condonation of delay and also rejected the Memorandum of appeal as being barred by limitation.
